answer:fe580db9-5f04-4c18-9c78-95ab71c03: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
answer:a66f7a75-cce5-4cbc-8733-62f376986: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:9b1ca0c6-f943-46c4-98db-446f0b233: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:02d673d6-87d7-4266-adc4-7b280c9c0: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
answer:a1028f91-5db1-4935-b01f-aeed638a7: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.
policy:05991daf-94a0-498b-8912-f927f9d42: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
